rule: Set include_flag=0 / diagnostic_only for bond_mtm rows in headline waterfall until owner promotes the gate; compute diagnostic dollars separately.
rationale: Duration price math is source-backed, but holder/cell/wrapper mapping remains proxy/unverified.

blocked_overlap: same fixed-rate security counted as both full coupon repricing and full MTM loss
rule: For fixed-rate securities, allow MTM price shock on security_id but block full contemporaneous coupon repricing on that same security_id; for floating/new/refi cashflow, set duration_price_leg=0 or use separate reset_leg_id.
rationale: Implements attached blocked construct: fixed-rate repricing and bondholder valuation never both on one security_id.

blocked_overlap: T-bill/MMF yield support and short-price mark both fully counted
rule: For bills/MMF-like assets already in safe-yield cashflow layer, only residual duration price mark can enter MTM; if no separate price_leg_id exists, set bond_mtm include_flag=0 for that short asset row.
rationale: Keeps income-flow N and valuation D from stacking on the same very-short security.

blocked_overlap: same fund/account sleeve included in equity/housing wealth and bond wealth
rule: Exposure namespace must distinguish bond_mtm:<security_or_fund_id>:<bucket> from equity_wealth:<ticker_or_index> and housing_wealth:<geo_property>; balanced funds must be sleeve-split before aggregation.
rationale: Equity/housing 6C remains headline; bond sleeve is separate and diagnostic unless promoted.

blocked_overlap: fund NAV counted and underlying securities counted again for same beneficial owner
rule: If fund_id NAV shock is counted, underlying security_id rows are classification/look-through only for that fund route; direct security rows may count only when beneficial_owner_route differs.
rationale: Look-through determines asset class/duration; it is not an additional owner claim.

blocked_overlap: retirement/insurance balance MTM plus credited-rate/cashflow on same policy/account fully counted
rule: Apply wrapper conversion/MTM relevance to DC/IRA/annuity/insurance routes; do not also count insurer credited-rate or pension cashflow layer on same plan_id/policy_id without a separate cashflow_leg_id.
rationale: ICI retirement ownership evidence implies visibility and near-term conversion differ by wrapper.

rule: Before entering waterfall, dedupe exact source_channel_id|exposure_id|month|cell_or_sector; exposure_id = bond_mtm|security_id_or_fund_id|duration_bucket|instrument_family|holder_route|cell.
rationale: Carries attached generic dedupe rule into the bond-MTM pack.
